description: Lite tier — cheapest OpenCode Zen ladder under the cost red line: ling-3.0-flash-fin-free handles flash queries with near-zero spend, gemini-3.5-flash-lite keeps standard orchestration steady, minimax-m2.7 delivers dependable coding without breaking the cap, and deepseek-v4-pro stays review-capable at max while respecting the cost limit; vision reuses gemini-3.5-flash-lite for attachments.
